tickets.name: Get on the Board
tickets.note: 76ers at Bulls, and the race to the first bucket starts at center court! Smith has to deal with Embiid in the circle, and that's a tall order, folks! That hands the 76ers the first possession, and that's half the battle! The Bulls get a stop? Then it's Smith running the other way for the first two! Powell is lurking on the weak side for the kick-out! The stakes are split so any one of them pays for the whole game. Beautiful!

tickets.name: Set Play
tickets.note: Lakers at Pistons, and here's how we see the opening act! The jump ball goes Kessler against Reed, and Kessler has the springs tonight! Win that tip and the Lakers are first in line to score. If Kessler wins the jump, he seals his man, and that's an easy two to start the night! Kessler is the lone value in this one, and we are HERE for it!

tickets.name: Out of the Huddle
tickets.note: Here comes Jazz at Timberwolves, and the opening tip is where our night begins! It's Hayes against Gobert in the circle, and neither one has the edge! Toss-up at the tip, but we trust the Jazz to cash the first trip! First play out of the timeout? Nope, first play of the game, and it's Bailey with the ball! Hayes is right behind him, ready to pounce on any mistake! One bucket from any of them and we're cashing. Wakey wakey, eggs and bakey!

tickets.name: Off the Tip

Wide open at the start, and we're riding the Nets! If Sharpe wins that tip, he goes right back to work, and he's the first look! Miss on the first look and Traore is crashing for the putback! Any of them scores first, and we're counting money!

tickets.name: The Starter
tickets.note: It's Heat and Kings, and buddy, we've got a plan for the opening act! It starts with Adebayo against Sabonis at center court, and our money says Adebayo gets up there first! Advantage Heat for the opening bucket. Tip it, run it, finish it. If Adebayo gets that jump, that's the whole plan! If that first look rims out, Wiggins is right there to clean it up! Should the Kings grab the first possession, Sabonis is our trigger man! Hit one, cover the game. Simple as that, folks!
